jobs.prompt: Pixel-art material style board for a cozy-horror autumn farming game, top-down straight-on 3/4 view, 3x3 grid of square material swatches each 32x32 pixels, no gaps, no text: row 1 = slate roof shingles in staggered half-rows with lit top edge and dark row shadow; vertical weathered timber plank wall with a lit left corner post and dark plank seams; rough fieldstone foundation blocks with chipped corners and dark mortar. Row 2 = oak bark with vertical grooves lit on the left third; autumn oak leaf masses in orange and red, shaded as volumes; meadow grass with tufts and warm tips. Row 3 = packed earth path with small pebble clusters; edge of a small-paned window with dark wooden frame and cool glass glint; dark blue-grey wool coat cloth with one fold. Key light from the upper left, shadows shift toward blue-violet, highlights toward warm yellow. Professional hand-placed pixel clusters of 2+ pixels, selective 1-pixel dark outlines, no dithered gradients, no noise, muted earthy palette.

jobs.style_image: upload:9404c18c-038b-4da3-ad7e-e93243b5d055 (= pl/anchors/board_c1.png), style_options default (palette, outline, detail, shading all on), usage 'Material style board: copy the shingle, timber, foundation stone and window rendering, outlines, cluster size and upper-left lighting'
jobs.prompt: Pixel-art game sprite: the front-left corner section of a weathered old wooden farmhouse, seen in straight-on 3/4 top-down view (front wall faces the viewer flat, no isometric angle, all horizontal lines level). Top: the lower edge of a dark blue-grey slate shingle roof with a thick overhanging eave and a fascia board, casting a dark shadow band onto the wall beneath. Middle: wall of horizontal weathered timber clapboard planks (each plank about 12 pixels tall, dark seams, grain along the plank), a lit square timber corner post on the far left edge. One small four-pane window with a dark wooden frame and sill, cool grey-blue glass with a glint, centred in the wall, its sill about 45 pixels above the ground. Bottom: a low rough fieldstone foundation band with chipped blocks and dark mortar. Right edge: the start of a wooden front porch, a plank deck one step high with one square porch post and a stone step in front. Key light from the upper left. Muted autumn horror-farm mood. Same material rendering, outline and shading as the style board. Transparent background, no ground, no shadow on the ground.

jobs.why: a transparent hole between the wall and the porch post, and a porch deck drawn on an isometric-style diagonal
jobs.prompt: Straight-on front view, no diagonal perspective: the horizontal timber clapboard wall continues to the right edge behind the porch, in deeper shade under the porch roof (same planks, one ramp step darker). One square wooden porch post standing in front of it, lit on its left side. At the bottom, the porch deck seen face-on as a level front edge: a thick horizontal fascia plank and the deck top as a narrow band of horizontal boards, one step high, with a fieldstone step centred below it. Every line level, matching the rest of the image exactly.

jobs.prompt: Render this farmhouse as finished premium 32 px pixel art in the reference's materials. Keep every edge, line, opening and the silhouette exactly where they are. Straight-on 3/4 top-down view, light from upper left, muted autumn palette, dark selective outlines. Hipped slate roof with 16 px courses, staggered slates of varied width, a shadow lip under each course, lighter near the ridge and darker toward the eave, lit west hip, shaded east hip, a few large soft moss patches, no speckle. Horizontal 12 px lap siding, silver-grey under the eave and warmer brown below, long sparse grain. Deep shadow under the eave. Irregular stone foundation, matching stone chimney with a cap. Clean thick timber trim on the door and windows, dark glass with small glints. No porch, no dormer, nothing added.
